tables.name: Yuan-ti Naming Method
tables.description: Ancestral Serpent Speech: 34%. Temple Orders & Oracles: 28%. Dynasties & Serpent Courts: 20%. River Kingdoms & Forgotten Cities: 12%. Surface-World Adopted Names: 6%. Two-part house/temple name is an app-friendly worldbuilding convention; canonical yuan-ti often use birth names alone.

results.description: Old inherited sibilant names: sinuous, often short, sometimes ceremonial. Standard Given Name + House/Temple Byname join.
